newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares advance, test of 1,090 seen.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares advance, test of 1,090 seen.

text.p: Austrian shares advanced 0.79 percent on Friday, hauled higher by demand for engineering firm VA Tech and industrial group OMV.
The ATX index of 21 blue-chip shares closed 8.46 points up at 1,081.33 and market participants said an underlying bullish tone could push prices higher in the coming week.
"A lot of people like the look of VA Tech at the moment and the prospect of another record year at OMV is definitely positive," said a trader.
OMV said earlier earnings this year could exceed 1995's record levels. VA Tech has reported full order books.
The ATX index could make an assault on 1,090 points ahead of the expiry next Friday of October futures, market participants said.
"I see the upward trend continuing, characterised by selective demand," one trader predicted.
Seven ATX issues closed down and 14 up. VA Tech was the biggest gainer, rising 40.5 schillings, or 2.8 percent, to 1,486 on brisk turnover.
OMV climbed 22 schillings to 1,094 and was also among the most actively traded shares.
Creditanstalt ordinary and preferred shares benefited from confirmation that the bank was on course to improve on last year's net profit.
October ATX futures climbed eight points to 1,083. The broad-based Vienna bourse index was 1.48 points up at 413.22. -- Vienna Newsroom 43-1-531 12 254
